goals.text: The developer's use case is specified as an HTTP API service.

terms.name: file
terms.definition: A file in the folder the tool is run on.

examples:
Feature: Rename files
  Rule: R-1
    @R-1 @E-1
    Scenario: A file is renamed
      Given a folder with the file "a.txt"
      When the user runs the tool to rename "a.txt" to "b.txt"
      Then the folder holds "b.txt" and no longer "a.txt"

questions.text: How should the new names be given?
